why_agent_cannot: identity verification is required and cannot be performed by an agent
what_human_must_do: Check that you are allowed in (see the list below). People in restricted places "are geofenced and blocked from accessing the protocol through Saturn's official UI", and the terms ban VPNs.
Open app.saturn.credit and connect a wallet on Ethereum, BNB Chain or Monad.

Get USDat. The app's M0 route mints it from USDC "without Saturn's direct-mint onboarding or wallet approval" for up to 3 USDC. "Direct minting with Saturn requires identity verification (KYC) and an approved wallet." You can also buy USDat in the Curve or PancakeSwap pools.
Keep the position open. Points build up daily until the season ends.
To leave sUSDat, "Queue at least 10 sUSDat shares", wait, then claim your USDat. The Season 2 page expects 3 to 7 days, while the FAQ says "Saturn targets same-day/T+1 processing".
costs: Orbital Points need money in USDat or sUSDat. There is no free route. The M0 route costs up to 3 USDC to mint, and redeeming costs "the larger of 3 USDC or 0.05% of your USDat input". The sUSDat vault charges "0% to deposit; 0.10% to withdraw" in regular mode and "0.25% to deposit; 0.50% to withdraw" in elevated mode, which applies outside US market hours and at weekends. Withdrawals pay out USDat
risks: The docs say: "Saturn is not available in: the United States, the European Economic Area, and any OFAC-sanctioned jurisdiction." The terms of service list more, among them Canada, Russia, Ukraine, Belarus, Venezuela and Zimbabwe.
